L42:   * Stronger Coding Capabilities: GLM-5.3 delivers a significant improvement in coding capabilities, achieving a 50% gain over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai Code Bench and reaching state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among open-source models on public benchmarks, including Terminal Bench 3.0.

L71:   * We’ve launched GLM-Image, a state-of-the-art image generation model built on a multimodal architecture and fully trained on domestic chips, combining autoregressive semantic understanding with diffusion-based decoding to deliver high-quality, controllable visual generation.
